cases.name: example_06_http_server_zero_triples
cases.description: Handler closures capture `next` but only call it — no capture writes -> 0 triples

cases.name: corpus_10_a5_http_handler_one_triple
cases.description: Closure writes `hits++` and passes to `mux.handle(...)` -> 1 triple (capture=hits, foreign_call=mux.handle)

cases.name: return_typed_closure_capture_write_detected
cases.description: Closures with explicit return types (`fn(...) bool`, `fn(...) (int, error)`) must not be skipped

cases.name: closure_params_and_local_declarations_ignored
cases.description: Writes to closure parameters (`count`) and closure-local bindings (`:=`, `var`) are not outer capture writes

cases.name: nested_non_escaping_closure_and_field_index_writes
cases.description: Field/index mutations attribute to the captured root (`state`, `counts`) while nested closure local writes do not leak
